A THREE-MINUTE WALKTHROUGH

Give Repro a real problem.

  1. Start the conversation. Say: “I’m trying to download my weekly report, but it keeps failing.”
  2. Share only the dashboard. Click “Open separately” on the dashboard. Then use the call’s screen-share control to select the “Northstar demo dashboard” tab or window.
  3. Try an export. Leave “All locations” selected. Let Repro ask what to try next.
  4. Compare another case. Switch to a single location and try again. Tell Repro why you need the report.
  5. Review the handoff. Correct any details, then copy the report.

This is a deliberately seeded product bug. The PAL should investigate it from your conversation and shared screen.

SMALL SURFACE. COMPLETE LOOP.

From conversation to evidence.

Tavus CVI hosts the live conversation. Raven observes the shared screen; the PAL chooses its next question.

One application tool, update_bug_report, sends structured findings to this page. The handler validates the payload, updates the draft and sends a tool result back.

Application events record actual sandbox export outcomes independently. The PAL cannot label its own claims as app-confirmed.

Browser-local state keeps this MVP small. No ticket publishing, account data, or automatic diagnosis.
